crossRefs.note: “ ‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a…
having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

translations.web: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
translations.bsb: But the open pastureland around their cities may not be sold, for this is their permanent possession.
translations.kjv: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
translations.asv: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
